title: The heron, first
logline: The first heron on the flats in the book, April 2024, at the channel's edge, and the pup, nine, still young enough to consider it, stopped mid-step. The page draws the considering. Three years later he'll just sit.

panels.composition: A great blue heron at a tidal channel's edge and a small three-legged dog stopped mid-step twenty feet away considering it, morning mist.
